subject: Seasonal p-values in ColExt MB GOF Test

messages.author: d65d060be3790aca
messages.subject: Seasonal p-values in ColExt MB GOF Test
parts:
Hello all,

I am running a Mackenzie-Bailey Goodness of Fit test (using AICcmodavg) on a dynamic occupancy model fit with colext. The model has 12 seasons fit, but one season was entirely unsampled. Normally when running mb.gof.test, the object returned has a list of p-values specific to each season from the model, but the output of these GOF tests with a missing season only returns a list of length one (instead or 12 or perhaps 11 as one might expect). Is this an expected behaviour? Is there a way to calculate the season-specific p-values when there is a missing season?

Thanks,
Rory
